placeholder.$description: Placeholder text is real text: held to 4.5:1 on field backgrounds, not dimmed to disabled.

brand.$description: Readable Qeet orange for text and icons: the AA step of the ramp, not the 500 fill.

link.$description: Links use the AA text step of the Qeet ramp. Deliberately not color.action.primary: the primary button is a Qeet Ember fill carrying a white label, while link text has to reach 4.5:1 on the page on its own.

on-brand.$description: White on the Qeet Ember action fill (action.primary, 4.56:1 at rest, 5.1:1 hover, 5.8:1 pressed). The same label in both themes: a filled Qeet control is white-on-ember everywhere.

on-feedback-strong.$description: The label on a feedback.<status>-strong fill (error, success, info).

on-warning-strong.$description: The label on feedback.warning-strong: near-black on amber, the hazard convention.

canvas.$description: The page. Light: a warm off-white, so white cards read as cards without heavy borders. Dark: neutral near-black (#0e0d0d), one step below the #131312 cards; never warm, which reads as brown at that lightness.

overlay.$description: Popovers, menus and dialogs. In dark mode the step above elevated, so an overlay separates by luminance first and shadow second.

brand-subtle.$description: The Qeet selected state (selected navigation, active tab, chosen filter, selected row or command item): a restrained warm tint in light, an ember-on-graphite surface in dark — Qeet without being orange everywhere. Pair it with text.primary or text.brand and, where a non-colour cue is needed, border.brand.

default.$description: Decorative: card edges and dividers. Not for identifying a control — that is border.control.

control.$description: The boundary that identifies an interactive control (inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios, switch tracks): ≥3:1 against every surface a control sits on (WCAG 1.4.11), unlike the decorative border.default.

brand.$description: A Qeet indicator that has to be seen without colour fill, e.g. the active-navigation bar or a selected tab underline: ≥3:1 on every surface.

primary.$description: Qeet Ember (#D04800) — filled primary actions and checked controls, in both themes, always with white text. #F26D0E (qeet.500) stays the brand colour; it carries white at only 3.0:1, so it is not an action fill.

success-subtle.$description: Subtle status backgrounds (alerts, inline messages, status badges): text.<status> on them holds 4.5:1.

error-strong.$description: Solid status fills for messages that must not be missed — a blocking error, an account suspension. Theme-invariant: the 700 step carries a white label (text.on-feedback-strong) at ≥5:1 in both themes. Warning is the exception by convention: amber 400 with a near-black label (text.on-warning-strong), because white on amber is unreadable and a dark amber reads as brown. Use sparingly; the subtle surfaces are the default.

ring.$description: Solid Qeet focus colour, ≥3:1 against every surface. Components may draw a translucent halo from it, but the indicator itself is this colour.

background.$description: Text selection: a Qeet tint that keeps selected text at ≥4.5:1.

rating.$description: Rating indicator roles. A star rating conveys its value by the *proportion* of each icon that is filled, so the fill hue is an affordance rather than the information — which is why the rating roles are left out of the contrast pairs src/__tests__/token-governance.test.ts measures (a recorded WCAG 1.4.11 exception).

surface-fade.$description: A quiet surface-to-background fade. Theme-aware, so light stops never appear in dark mode.
